cues: Chewed and mixed with saliva in the mouth.
Pushed down the oesophagus by peristalsis.
Churned in the acid stomach into chyme.
Digested and absorbed along six metres of small intestine.
And in the large intestine, water is taken back and faeces are formed.
text: Follow a mouthful. Chewed and mixed with saliva in the mouth. Pushed down the oesophagus by peristalsis. Churned in the acid stomach into chyme. Digested and absorbed along six metres of small intestine. And in the large intestine, water is taken back and faeces are formed.
